---
name: italian-unit-check
description: Use to check a new lesson or unit against the approved Italian plan before calling it done.
---

Check the new unit against these rules:

1. Italian only for now — no Sicilian content yet.
2. Picture, object, or scene first — no English translation as the main route.
3. Visual, verbal, and written practice are all present.
4. Words are A1 level and fit the unit's scene.
5. Added words from the front end appear in practice.

List what passes, what fails, and fix only the failures. Stop and wait for Maria to check it.
